title: Numbers Eleven to Twenty and Weather
label: ch:ta-numbers-and-weather
canDo: I can count eleven to twenty as the transparent compounds they are, and say what the weather is doing.

payoff.summary: Count 11 and 12 as ten-plus-a-digit and take irupathu apart as "two-tens", then take vāṉilai apart into vāṉam plus nilai and report the weather with mazhai peykiRathu.
payoff.note: TA-C20-vaanilai assesses five of the chapter's six atoms: all three number atoms (TA-C20-pathinondru-irupathu, now a prerequisite) and both weather atoms. The letter ய (TA-SCRIPT-RECOG-124, TA-S124-letter-ya, 711) is taught after the payoff and is not assessed.
